title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ServiceLevelObjective
description: Service level objectives are defined in terms of parameters and metrics, thresholds, and tolerances associated with the parameters. (TM Forum TMF657 Service Quality Management 4.0.0, Swagger definition ServiceLevelObjective; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceLevelObjective:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ServiceLevelObjective'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ServiceLevelObjective:<tmfId>. The identifier of a service level objectives.

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/href'. The hyperlink to access a service level objective.

conformanceComparator.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/conformanceComparator'. An operator that specifies whether a Service Level Objective is violated above or below the conformanceTarget.

conformanceTarget.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/conformanceTarget'. A value used to determine if Service Level Objective is met. The data type should be adjusted case by case.

graceTimes.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/graceTimes'. The number of times an objective can remain un-updated without a violation of a Service Level Agreement in reference to a measurement period and/or Service Level Agreement reporting period.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/name'. The name of the service level objectives.

thresholdTarget.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/thresholdTarget'. A value that used to specify when a warning should be used that indicates an objective is danger of not being met. Notice, the data type should be adjusted case by case.

toleranceTarget.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/toleranceTarget'. A value that specifies the allowable variation of a conformance Target. The data type should be adjusted case by case.

conformancePeriod.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/conformancePeriod'. An interval of time during which the Conformance Target must be measured.

serviceLevelObjectiveConsequence.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/serviceLevelObjectiveConsequence'. A list of consequences for this objective.

serviceLevelObjectiveParameter.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/serviceLevelObjectiveParameter'. A parameter for this objective

tolerancePeriod.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/tolerancePeriod'. A value that specifies the allowable time variation of a conformance

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF657_ServiceQualityManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF657-ServiceQualityManagement-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/ServiceLevelObjective/properties/validFor'. A valid duration of a thing.

ServiceLevelSpecParameter.description: Service Level Specification parameters can be one of two types. A Key Quality Indicator (KQI) provides a measurement of a specific aspect of the performance of a Product (i.e., Product Specification, Product Offering, or Product) or a Service (i.e., Service Specification or Service).

parameterType.description: Types of Service Level Specification parameters are KQI or KPI

serviceParmCategory.description: A string that specifies whether the Service Level Specification Parameter is technology specific, service specific, or technology/service independent

serviceParmPerspective.description: A string that specifies whether the Service Level Specification Parameter represents a single user instance parameter or a parameter that represents an aggregation

transformationAlgorithmOfKQI.description: The description of a logical step-by-step procedure used to calculate the value of a KQI
